description: This file defines data structures and utility functions related to sharing gateway relay settings, including configuration storage, retrieval, and management using UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the provided relay configuration to UserDefaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Stores the last event message with a timestamp in UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from UserDefaults.
